itemCount.description: Logical collection total, including offscreen members. UINT32_MAX means unknown; zero means a known empty collection. Only valid on the list role.

itemPosition.description: Zero-based logical item position within its owning collection. UINT32_MAX means unknown. Only valid on the list-item role; not a visible sibling index.

positionSource.description: Position authority: 0 uses itemPosition; 1 uses the enclosing repeated artboard occurrence logical index. Source 1 is valid only for a complete single-member template with unknown authored itemPosition.
